hotspots.name: A Brass Plate On A Narrow Door
hotspots.description: Sherlock Moriarty, Private Investigator. You screwed the plate on yourself, and the name is a joke nobody in this country is equipped to get.

hotspots.name: The Mouth Of An Alley
hotspots.description: Backlund’s East District after dark: fog with soot in it, and a trade in people that the constabulary has agreed with itself is somebody else’s district.

hotspots.name: A Chapel With Its Windows Bricked Up
hotspots.description: The bricks are new and the mortar is wrong, and somebody has been carrying a great deal of water in here for a building with no font.

hotspots.name: The Circle
hotspots.description: Chalked on the boards of a rented room above a chandler’s shop, and swept up every morning before the landlady comes.

hotspots.name: The Backlund Requisition Office
hotspots.description: A counter in a building with no sign, where the Church sells its own people what the Church has already decided they may have.
